column_description: Full name of the user. may be NULL.
Email address of the user. may be NULL.
Role of the user (e.g., administrator, artist, developer). always exactly one of 'administrator', 'artist', 'developer'. may be NULL.
Hashed password of the user. may be NULL.
Date and time of the user's last login. may be NULL.
Status of the user (e.g., active, inactive, suspended). always exactly one of 'active', 'inactive', 'suspended'. may be NULL.
